cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: C1 pattern - Sodium Laureth Sulfate #2 buffered by Cocamidopropyl Betaine #4 and Coco-Glucoside #11, refatter Glyceryl Oleate #12; no second anionic or reset route/intent.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: one cationic polymer (Hydroxypropyl Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride #13) plus several light routes (Hydrolyzed Wheat Protein #7, Panthenol #9, Glyceryl Oleate #12, Hydrogenated Palm Glycerides Citrate #16, PEG-3 Distearate #17, Glycerin #19). Silicone-free; not a clearly rich 2-in-1 architecture despite the 2in1 label (claims cannot assign conditioning, 3.2).
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: 'Shampoo & Spülung 2in1' positioning; but no silicone or fatty alcohol.

weightPotential.rationale: Low: light, low-persistence routes only (guar #13, glyceryl oleate #12, pearlizer #17, protein #7) in an effective SLES/betaine base; no silicone or oil payload.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: A 2-in-1 build can carry more cationic polymer than INCI order reveals; interacting light routes are the realistic path to moderate, recorded as neighbor.

focusPrimary.rationale: Volume: 'Volumen' in product name and 'verleiht auch kraftlosem und feinem Haar Volumen'; silicone-free low-weight formula is compatible (7.2 row 1).
focusPrimary.counterSignal: 2-in-1 conditioning positioning is a counter-signal for lift.
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Blind: light conditioning, low weight -> volume-compatible. Unblind: name 'Volumen' -> volume.

focusSecondary.rationale: Empty: 2-in-1 care is a restatement of conditioning (§8 condition 3); no other distinct positioning.

usageRole.rationale: Regular: no daily/frequent, reset or treatment trigger.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: No sensitive/itchy/dry-scalp positioning ('dermatologisch bestätigt', 'pH-hautneutral' are tolerability statements).

projection.thicknessRationale: T1 W low, C moderate: fine ideal, normal ideal, coarse acceptable. T2: 'feines Haar'/volume claims ignored. T4: W neighbor moderate would make fine acceptable -> review_thickness_boundary (fine); normal unchanged; coarse unchanged.
projection.cleansingIntensityRationale: I1: moderate -> regular; I3: no neighbor.
projection.liveComparison: Not evaluated (live rows not in sealed packet).

uncertainties: §5 'clearly rich 2-in-1 architecture' is not defined; a product labelled 2in1 with only guar + light routes was treated as not rich.
Positioning evidence is retailer-only; §7 does not grade source tier for focus (E1 grading applies only to projection).
